**panel**

_Vue template ref_

```vue
<div ref="panel">
```

Static template ref resolved through `useTemplateRef()`.

**Editor behavior**
- Hover and go-to-definition jump to the authored `useTemplateRef()` binding.
- When the type backend is available, hover upgrades to the binding's exact TypeScript type.

**Docs**

[Vue Template Refs](https://vuejs.org/guide/essentials/template-refs.html)
